title: The Battery That Refuses to Explode | NOVA
summary: A short NOVA excerpt in which David Pogue abuses a Tufts-developed battery by cutting and damaging it, and it keeps working without catching fire. It comes from the documentary 'Search for the Super Battery'.
why: Cited repeatedly as a quick visual demonstration that solid-state or polymer batteries can survive abuse without igniting.

quote.text: Video shows it continuing to provide power while being sliced into pieces with scissors
